title: Karlovy Vary Day Trip from Prague
short_description: The spa town of colonnades and hot springs, at your own pace. Door to door in your own Mercedes from your Prague address, with your chauffeur waiting and one price for the whole car.
description:
Karlovy Vary, or Carlsbad, is the largest spa town in the Czech Republic. Its hot springs rise under a line of colonnades along the river Teplá, and visitors still walk from one to the next with a porcelain cup, as they have since the days of Goethe and Beethoven.

The town lies west of Prague, most of the way on the D6 motorway. A day is enough to walk the colonnades, taste the springs, have lunch and see the Grandhotel Pupp.

A private car matters here for a practical reason: the spa centre is largely closed to traffic. A chauffeur who knows the town brings you as close to the colonnades as the rules allow, and waits there.

Your chauffeur collects you at your address in Prague and drives you to Karlovy Vary. The car then waits for the time included in your booking, shown next to the price. You can add extra hours when you book. Time beyond your booking on the day is charged only after a person at Prestigo agrees to it.

The price is for the whole car, not per person. It covers the drive there and back, fuel, motorway tolls and your time in Karlovy Vary. You see the total before you pay, and the same car and chauffeur bring you back to your door.

Your chauffeur is a professional driver, not a guide. Entrance tickets, guided tours and meals are not included. If you would like a licensed local guide, book one for the hours you plan to be there and we will help you time the day around it.
highlights: The Mill Colonnade, the Market Colonnade and the Hot Spring Colonnade with its geyser, all within a short walk
Warm mineral spring water, sipped from a porcelain cup
Coffee at the Grandhotel Pupp at the end of the promenade
The funicular up to the Diana lookout tower above the town
Moser glass and the Becherovka museum, if you want a visit
A chauffeur who brings you as close to the colonnades as the traffic rules allow

itinerary.title: Pickup at your Prague address
itinerary.body: Your chauffeur meets you at the door of your hotel or apartment in Prague at the time you chose.

itinerary.title: Drive west to the spa town
itinerary.body: Most of the way runs on the D6 motorway through the hills of West Bohemia, then down into the narrow valley of the river Teplá.

itinerary.title: Drop-off near the colonnades
itinerary.body: The spa centre is largely closed to traffic. Your chauffeur drops you as close as the rules allow and tells you where the car will wait.

itinerary.title: The colonnades and the springs
itinerary.body: Walk from one colonnade to the next. Drinking cups are sold at stalls along the way. The spring water is warm and mineral, and most people sip rather than drink it.

itinerary.title: The Pupp, the lookout or a glass museum
itinerary.body: Stop for coffee at the Grandhotel Pupp, ride the funicular up to the Diana lookout tower, or visit Moser glass or the Becherovka museum. Check opening hours before you travel.

itinerary.title: Back to the car
itinerary.body: Call or message your chauffeur when you are ready. The car is waiting where you were dropped off.

itinerary.title: Return to your Prague address
itinerary.body: The same car and chauffeur bring you back to the same address in Prague where the day began.

includes: A private Mercedes with your own chauffeur, for your party only
Pickup and return at your address in Prague
The drive to Karlovy Vary and back
Waiting time at the destination for the hours included in your booking
Child seats at no charge: tell us the children’s ages when you book
One price for the whole car, shown in full before you pay
excludes: Entrance tickets for museums and tours, and the cost of a drinking cup
A guide or a guided tour: your chauffeur drives and waits, but is not a guide
Extra hours beyond your booking, unless you add them when you book
pickup_info: Pickup and return are at your address in Prague: a hotel, an apartment or an office. Tell us the exact address when you book. Before the day you receive your chauffeur’s name and phone number, and on the day they wait at the door at the agreed time. A stop on the way, such as Loket Castle, is not part of this trip; ask for a custom tour instead.
important_info:
The colonnades are free to walk at any time of year. The spring water is warm and mineral, so most people sip rather than drink it.

During the Karlovy Vary International Film Festival in early July the town is very busy and traffic rules in the centre change. Book early for those dates and allow more time.

The spa centre is largely closed to traffic, so the car cannot wait right at the colonnades. Your chauffeur tells you where it is.

Museums and glassworks have their own opening hours and tour times. Check them before you travel.

Your chauffeur drives and waits, but is not a guide. Entrance tickets and guided tours are not included.

faq.q: How is the price worked out?
faq.a: There is one price for the whole car, set for each car class. It covers the drive there and back, fuel, motorway tolls and the hours at the destination included in your booking. You can add extra hours when you book, and you see the total before you pay.

faq.q: Does the chauffeur wait and drive us back the same day?
faq.a: Yes. The same car and chauffeur take you to Karlovy Vary, wait for the time you booked and drive you back to your Prague address. Waiting during the hours in your booking is part of the price.

faq.q: What if we want to stay longer on the day?
faq.a: Tell your chauffeur. Time beyond your booking is charged only after a person at Prestigo agrees to it, at the same extra-hour price you saw when you booked. Nothing is charged automatically.

faq.q: Is a guide or an entrance ticket included?
faq.a: No. The price covers the car and the chauffeur. Tickets and guided tours are booked separately, and the chauffeur does not act as a guide. We are glad to help you time the day around a guide or a ticket slot you have booked.

faq.q: Can we stop at Loket Castle on the way?
faq.a: A stop on the way is not part of this trip. If you want one, or a day with several stops, send us a custom tour request and we plan it with you.

faq.q: How many people fit in one car?
faq.a: Up to three passengers in an E-Class or S-Class and up to six in a V-Class. Larger groups travel in two or more cars. Child seats are free in every class.
